name: CC-OCR
intro: CC-OCR基准旨在全面评估大型多模态模型在光学字符识别（OCR）方面的能力。它涵盖了多场景文本阅读、多语言文本阅读、文档解析和关键信息提取四个核心OCR任务。该基准包含39个子集，共7,058张完全标注的图像，其中41%来源于真实应用场景并首次发布。CC-OCR通过多样化的场景、任务和挑战，旨在推动LMM在OCR中心任务上的持续进步。
org: Alibaba Group, South China University of Technology
build_method: 合格公开标注复用、选定数据重标注、新应用数据采集、模型预标注、跨模型验证与人工修正
metric: Eval-Trans, Eval-Pos, NED, TEDS, 字段级F1, 定位精确率/召回率, R_rep
task_type: 图像问答, 文本识别, 信息抽取
eval_feature: 四条OCR赛道、任务专属输出格式与指标、多方向和重复诊断
drawio_review_note: REDRAW review aligned with arXiv:2412.02210v3 Sections 3.2-3.4 and 4, official AdvancedLiterateMachinery snapshot fb6187ebe5374d5682ac0bc05f31e3639ab6fb15, and CC-OCR dataset snapshot c64517e92179991d509776064174776700cdd5a2. The corrected source topology directly reuses qualified public annotations and applies model pre-annotation, cross-model validation, and manual correction only to new or re-annotated labels, with OCR-expert / LLM review shown only where the paper reports it. It then merges the pools into four tracks, 39 subsets, and 7,058 fully annotated images, retaining the reported 41% newly released real-application share, output formats, task metrics, and OCR robustness diagnostics.
task_type_en: Visual Question Answering, Text Recognition, Information Extraction
build_method_en: Qualified Public Annotation Reuse, Selected Re-annotation, New Application Data Collection, Model Pre-annotation, Cross-model Validation, Manual Correction
eval_feature_en: Four OCR Tracks, Task-specific Output Formats and Metrics, Multi-orientation and Repetition Diagnostics
intro_en: The CC-OCR benchmark aims to comprehensively evaluate large multimodal models' capabilities in optical character recognition (OCR). It covers four core OCR tasks: multi-scene text reading, multilingual text reading, document parsing, and key information extraction. The benchmark includes 39 subsets with a total of 7,058 fully annotated images, 41% of which come from real-world applications and are newly released. By offering diverse scenarios, tasks, and challenges, CC-OCR seeks to drive continuous progress of LMMs in core OCR tasks.
